But the session stayed in the sidebar for 12 hours, or until you archived it. With this change, the plugin archives the session approximately two minutes after the merge, like the auto-settle of T3 Code. The pull request is the pull request that the badge in the sidebar shows.\n\nThe merge archives a session only if the last run of the session started before the merge. The comparison uses the start of the run, not the end, because the agent can merge the pull request in its own run. A follow-up that you send after the merge starts a new run, and thus keeps the session. An unarchive by hand after the merge also keeps the session. A new message in an archived session unarchives it, as before.\n\nFor each session that does not run, the sweep gets the current branch of its folder from `vcs.get`. Then the sweep finds the pull request with the `gh` command of the badge. The sessions of one folder share one lookup, and a folder on its default branch gets no `gh` call. The sweep runs in the main process, thus the shell helper of the window moved to `src/shell.js`. To archive a session soon after its merge, the sweep now runs every 2 minutes, not every 10 minutes.\n\nThe plugin uses the current branch of the folder, not the branch at the time of the run. If sessions share a folder, for example the project folder, a merge archives each of these sessions that has no run after the merge. A session in a removed worktree gets no archive after a merge. `archiveAfterHours: 0` also stops the archive after a
